en:
Plus, if I don't get my article fee today, I'm gonna lose
most of my fingers, and I won't be able to stroke
Milky-chan's creamy thighs ever again!

All right, all right. Don't shout. I'll call her up, but you
do the persuading.
Hello? Milky-chan?
Oh, Ta-chan... I'm so sorry...

Well... It's my little brother. He handles theft prevention
over at Kubota Security.
Go on...

He broke whatever they were transporting, and since it was
expensive, they're holding him responsible!

Even worse, his boss is making death threats! And he's got
him locked up in his office!
Can you... not just call the police or something?
But his boss knows all the top officers at the station.

Plus he's always threatening people, saying he can rally the
Nagoya Family just to teach them a lesson.
The Nagoya Family, huh?
Who knows what horrors would happen if I took this to the cops?
Oh, I'm so worried... I'm in no state for an interview.
I'm sorry, Ta-chan. I need to go.

Wait! If your brother's safely released, won't that make it
all better?
Then you could come and get interviewed today!
Maybe... but what can I do?
You said he works at Kubota Security? Let me handle it.

Meanwhile, you just get yourself ready for work and wait
till I get back.
Boss man, you know where Kubota Security is?
It's on Icho Street, I think. What, Ta-chan, you're leaving?
Yeah, my job and my fingers are riding on this!
Let's play Taiko No Tatsujin!

I'm not gettin' any exercise lately.
Me too. I'm so busy with work that when I do finally get a day off, I'm in no mood to go and work out.
But I can't let this get outta hand. I just bought a suit to go job huntin', and I gotta make sure I fit in my dresses I wear to the club.
I don't think you have anything to worry about, but then why not try going to the gym?
Nah, that ain't my style. Exercisin' justa exercise? That's so borin'. It'd get old way too fast for me.
I wish there was a way to burn fat while still havin' fun.
Why not try dancing? That'll help you melt away the fat whether you want to or not.
Dancin', huh? Sometimes I practice the real simple stuff at home.
Idol groups are real popular lately, right? If a client asks me to do a song at karaoke, I gotta make sure I know the dance routine.
Good point. They make those dances pretty simple so that people can copy the moves without too much difficulty.
Yeah! And if I can pull it off, I feel like I've accomplished somethin'!
So, why not try some more songs? By the time you've mastered the dance moves, I bet your body would be in better shape.
Okay! I wonder what songs would be good? Maybe I oughta check out some music shows on TV!
There's no easy way to do it. Everybody struggles. Maintaining good looks is like looking for a job. It's never as straightforward as it seems.
I know all that! That's why I'm stressin' out every which way.
And how 'bout you, Akiyama-san? Ain't ya worried about your weight?
Yeah, well. Lately, it's been weighing on me.
I bought this dieting gadget that looked like it might be good from a shopping channel on TV. But I only used it two or three times before I quit.
I thought if I could do it while watching TV, I'd be able to keep it up, but it was a lot more hassle than I'd bargained for.
Ya see? You can't try to cheat your way to weight loss while watchin' television. Ya gotta work out properly!
Wait, when did the tables get turned here?
Maybe eat less? That way you'll be able to drop weight without exercising that much.
You're sayin' that now? Tellin' me to watch what I eat when you're takin' me out to dinner? Yer evil, Akiyama-san.
Hey, I didn't say not to eat anything. All I'm suggesting is that you watch what you eat, and maybe order one fewer dish.
You won't need to spend money on working out, and your dining expenses will drop. You're killing two birds with one stone. Give it a try.
Hmm. Like I get what ya mean, but...
Right now I'm eatin'! The diet can start tomorrow!
Sheesh. That sounds likely.
Sorry. I have some urgent business to get to.

Ever since I saw it on TV the other day, I've been thinkin' about giving horse ridin' a shot.
Horse riding? What brought that up?
I mean, I can ride a merry-go-round just fine, but I've never ridden a real horse, y'know?
What kind of reasoning is that?
Horses got pretty eyes. And there aren't that many animals that can carry a person on their back, right?
I see. I suppose it has a different sort of appeal than riding a car or a motorcycle.
But isn't horse riding expensive? I don't think a college student can afford it.
That's why I wanna try it! I'd be a bit like a celeb to have ridin' horses as a hobby! It might make my newscaster job application more appealin'!
I can see that. It gives off an image of being from an old, established family more than just being new money.
I know, right!?
But it might be too late to start now. Girls like that all get started when they're still little kids.
That'd make it all the more impressive to pull off. It's a bit tough to get into things like tea ceremony and Japanese dance as a hobby.
Bein' serious about my job search cuts into my free time though. I wish I'd started earlier.
It'd still be nice to ride a horse at least once. Maybe if you have the time, you can go to an event that offers trial rides.
Good idea! If I go, I'll invite you to come too!
You want me to ride a horse, too?
You might get hurt. Horses are prideful animals. They say the horse chooses the rider, not the other way around.
Aww, are ya worried about me?
Of course. You can get seriously injured if you aren't skilled enough. That's ample excuse for me to worry.
Being thrown from a horse is bad, but getting trampled or kicked can be life-threatening.
Horses are wild animals. They aren't like the cute wooden horses in merry-go-rounds.
I see... The folks on TV seemed to have an easy enough time ridin' them, so I figured it wasn't anythin' outta the ordinary.
If you're serious about doing it, you need to really learn your stuff in order to not wind up getting hurt.
Why not try horse racing? If all you want to do is see real horses, that should be good enough.
Horse racin', huh? I guess that would let me see real horses, but it doesn't have that celebrity mystique to it at all.
Oh no, it takes major funds to own a racehorse. I've considered owning one myself.
That's not really what I'd consider a hobby though. Sounds more like a job to me.
Besides, a girl who's into racehorses would come off like a creepy old dude, and who wants to date a girl like that?
You think so? I know some pretty good-looking guys who are into horse racing, and I bet they would like you.
Wow, really? Goin' on a date to see horses could be pretty neat! <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
